description: This source file defines a singly linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and counting elements. It includes an internal Node class and a companion object for auxiliary functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation supporting basic operations such as add, remove, get, and size.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.
